_README: MARKER-ONLY. Never fetched by the student's browser until a teacher/marker PDF is generated (formative: automatically when the student clicks Generate; assessed: only via the ?teacher=1-gated action, after Final Submit). Never render any of this on the student-facing page. See CLAUDE.md §5's assessment-security amendment.

markingScheme.criterion: Names at least two real requests from their own Boutique Record, quoting the exact demonstrative used (e.g. 'esa falda', 'aquel abrigo').
markingScheme.accept: Any two genuine logged requests from the student's own Record that show a demonstrative word; exact spelling/accents not required.
markingScheme.insufficient: A general claim ('I used este and ese') with no actual customer requests quoted from their own Record.

markingScheme.criterion: Correctly links este/esta to aquí (close), ese/esa to ahí (near the listener/middle distance), and aquel/aquella to allí (far), for the examples given.
markingScheme.accept: Equivalent phrasing of the same three-way distance rule (e.g. 'here/there/over there'); exact Spanish adverbs not required as long as the three distances are distinguished correctly.
markingScheme.insufficient: Naming the demonstrative words without linking each one to its distance.

markingScheme.criterion: Mentions that the demonstrative's ending must also match the gender (and number) of the noun, e.g. esta camisa vs este jersey.
markingScheme.accept: Any correct statement that the form changes with masculine/feminine (and singular/plural) nouns, using their own or a general example.
markingScheme.insufficient: Stating the demonstrative changes 'depending on the word' with no mention of gender/number agreement.

markingScheme.criterion: Correctly contrasts speed/scale: fast fashion designs arrive in stores rapidly (Zara/Inditex, roughly twice a week) and are mass-produced, while backstrap-loom weaving is slow, handmade, and can take months for one piece.
markingScheme.accept: Any correct statement of the speed/scale contrast, even without exact figures — mass/fast vs. slow/handmade is the key point.
markingScheme.insufficient: Saying weaving is 'slower' with no sense of scale (mass-produced vs. one-of-a-kind) or timescale.

markingScheme.criterion: Mentions the cultural or symbolic value of Indigenous weaving (e.g. patterns/colours carry meaning, identity, or tradition), not just that it takes longer to make.
markingScheme.accept: Any correct reference to meaning, identity, tradition or heritage carried in the weaving, in the student's own words.
markingScheme.insufficient: Repeating that it is 'slower' or 'more careful' without naming any cultural or symbolic significance.

markingScheme.criterion: Correctly conjugates llevar or ponerse in the first person (llevo.../me pongo...) with at least one cold-weather clothing item, matching the el/la article correctly.
markingScheme.accept: Either verb, any correct first-person form, with any genuinely cold-weather item (abrigo, bufanda, guantes, jersey/suéter, gorro) and correct article agreement.
markingScheme.insufficient: Naming a cold-weather item with no conjugated verb, or using a non-first-person form (e.g. 'te pones').

Understandable but with unclear phrasing or missing key Spanish terms.

markingInstructions: Mark ONLY the two constructed responses (Explain, Apply). Award marks point-by-point using each question's markingScheme: each point is worth the marks stated, is independent unless it names a dependsOn point (in which case only award it if that earlier point was also awarded), and each point's 'accept'/'insufficient' tell you exactly what does and doesn't count. use_of_evidence's 3 marks ARE the Explain markingScheme's 3 points, and cultural_reasoning's 3 marks ARE the Apply markingScheme's 3 points — the rubric levels restate the same points as bands; award each set of 3 marks ONCE, not twice. communication is a separate, holistic 2 marks across both answers' clarity and vocabulary, never overlapping with the content marks. Copy auto_marked_score into knowledge_accuracy. Use the student's own logged Boutique Record (the cliente/zona/elegido/resultado/precio columns in simulation_results.trials) to verify any customer request, distance or item they claim to quote — do not take their prose summary on trust if it does not match their own logged data. Accept valid alternative wording and minor accent/spelling slips if meaning is clear; do not penalise for a missing written accent unless it changes the meaning of the word. Total is out of 15 (7 auto + 3 + 3 + 2). Report total, percentage, one strength, one correction, one next step, under 80 words.
